assumptions_and_unknowns: No production deployment or operational-readiness claim is included in this package.
No database, ORM, persistence provider, API architecture, authentication model, billing model, or recommendation engine is selected.
No Stage 03 feature implementation is included or authorized by this package.
Any material change to the judged repository state after this freeze requires a new package version and digest.

architecture_constraints: modules are created only for concrete product capabilities.
shared is created only for proven cross-boundary reuse.
conceptual domain vocabulary is Certification, Issuer, CertificationPath, UserProgress.
handoff_candidate.enabled_only_if: task.skillcertify.02.014 records human outcome pass bound to this exact package version and digest
governance_constraints: AI/Codex does not write directly to main.
Human review is required for material decisions and merge.

risks_and_limitations: npm audit is dependency-focused and does not prove application security.
Current secret review covered tracked content and common credential markers, not the full Git history.
No automated remote CI, SAST, or dedicated secret-scanning workflow is currently configured.
Accessibility and responsive coverage must expand as real screens and interactions are added.
Module/domain boundaries remain intentionally conceptual until concrete Stage 03 behavior justifies physical ownership.
GitHub Project WIP/status enforcement remains partly human-operational.
The AI POC decision is limitar: AI remains assistive and governed, not autonomous.
